description: Absolute-form target with a fragment (MCPWARP.md §4.2 Target row, §4.3): `http://notes-tester.mcpwarp.test/mcp?a=1#x` is cut at the first `#`, then to its path + query as written, so the handler sees `https://<Host>/mcp?a=1`: the URL is built from the Host header, not the target's own scheme and authority, and the fragment is gone. Companion of target_fragment_dropped (origin-form).
in:
POST http://notes-tester.mcpwarp.test/mcp?a=1#x HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: The fragment is cut before any URL construction, so a runtime URL parser never sees it.
